Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Debu: Not recommended. Enables detailed Character Creation Customizer logs.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_QOL_: Shows each major skill's final starting level after applying the profession, traits, and Customizer settings.
Shows each skill's effective XP multiplier after applying level scaling, learner traits, Crafty, Pacifist, and MultiplierConfig.
Shows each profession's configured Points to Spend value next to its name.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Init: Adds or removes this skill's starting level during character creation. Values range from -10 to 10.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Trai: Prevents this trait from being selected during character creation.
Allows this profession-only trait to be purchased during character creation.
Changes the points spent or gained when selecting this trait.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Prof: Hides this profession from character creation.
Changes the points gained or spent when selecting this profession.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Gran: Replaces the traits granted by this profession. Enter trait names separated by commas.
Adds these items when this profession is selected. Enter full item types (Base.ItemName) separated by commas.
